about_the_game:
We always thought that extraterrestrial life was out of reach until the day of disaster. The illusion of humanity has been shattered, and aliens are not friendly visitors, but invaders who destroy everything. Without warning or negotiation, their first wave of attacks fell on Russia, followed by the spread of war to China, and subsequently, the United States was not spared. In the end, the world fell into panic, civilization was on the brink of collapse, and people realized that this was not just a war, but the ultimate challenge concerning the survival of humanity.

In order to resist the ruthless invasion of alien fleets, countries around the world have abandoned their prejudices and, under the joint leadership and cooperation of China, the United States, and Russia, have created the most advanced space command center and combat platform in history - the "Hope". This is a battle without a way out, where the most elite pilots of humanity will pilot the pinnacle works created by various countries, charge towards the battlefield, and engage in a life and death struggle with alien fleets.

At this moment of life and death, we cannot wait for miracles to come. The end of the world is near, but humanity will not surrender. Today, we set aside our past differences and join hands to fight against alien invaders. In this battle, we must save our homeland with our own hands!

High degree of freedom fighter aircraft control

This game adopts a first/third person perspective, where players will take on the role of one of humanity's top combat pilots and engage in intense battles in outer space. Driving the most advanced space fighter jets manufactured by various countries, conducting 360 degree blind spot air combat.

DIY assemble your own fighter jet

You can choose spacecrafts manufactured in different countries for assembly, which can be equipped with various weapons such as energy cannons, missiles, laser beams, etc., and can be deeply modified to adapt to different combat scenarios.

Dynamic Battlefield and Real Physics Engine

Using Unreal Engine 5 to create a realistic zero gravity combat experience. The combat environment includes meteorite belts, space station debris, planetary orbits, etc. All scenes are interactive, providing players with a highly challenging combat environment.
